reply.text: I'll pull up your recent training to see where you stand. You haven't logged any sessions or programs yet, so I can't see what those 8 weeks looked like. If you start logging your workouts in the app, I can track your volume and intensity and give you a real answer on whether a deload makes sense — things like whether your lifts are stalling, how many sessions a week you've been hitting, and how your rep quality is trending matter more than the calendar. For now, the general rule is: if you're still moving weight cleanly and making small progress, keep going. If you're grinding everything and missing reps you should hit, that's when a deload earns its keep.
